title: 建築エンジニアリング総合演習Ａ
subtitle: Architectural Integrated Exercises for engineering A
teachers:
TSUCHIDA Yoshio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will conduct comprehensive exercises in the structural and environmental fields of architecture. They will learn the technology and design skills to realize living spaces that are environmentally friendly and comfortable, as well as safe and secure.
advice:
Course work for experiments and exercises by learning area:

[Structural experiments]
・Concrete production and compressive strength testing
・Reinforcing bar tensile tests
・Static loading test of truss structures
・Wood compression experiments

[Environmental experiments]
・Measurement and evaluation of solar radiation
・Landscape evaluation
・Measurement and evaluation of odor and airborne substances
・Proposal and evaluation of thermal/light environments
・Energy-saving diagnosis

Credits will not be awarded unless all report assignments are submitted. Lateness or absences carry great point deductions.
requiredKnowledge:
Actively prepare for each theme and discover issues to consider.
Review the subjects taken in the first and second years.
Experiment with clothes that are safe to work in.
Bring a personal computer, notebook, and writing instrument for data reduction.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain various architectural phenomena through experiments and exercises.
Students can analyze data on various phenomena related to structures and the architectural environment.
Students can create logical, objective, and easy-to-understand reports based on experimental results.
Students have a positive attitude toward class. They keep strict deadlines with no late arrivals nor absences.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・ Experimental purpose and method are set appropriately. The resulting discussion is logically assembled. Measures taken to address each problem are concrete and clear.

・ The purpose, method, and results are expressed easily. Phenomena are explained using theory.
achievementLevels.standard:
・ Experimental purpose and method are set appropriately. The results are examined and countermeasures to address the problems are proposed.

・ The purpose, method, and results are expressed easily. Students understand the theory so that they grasp the phenomena.

              キーワード
              学習・教育目標

              1.Archtectual structure / environment exercises
2.Thermal, air, light environments
3.Psychological/ environmental design
4.Loading test / Compression test
5.Simulation / Analysis

              Students will conduct comprehensive exercises in the structural and environmental fields of architecture. They will learn the technology and design skills to realize living spaces that are environmentally friendly and comfortable, as well as safe and secure.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Course work for experiments and exercises by learning area:

[Structural experiments]
・Concrete production and compressive strength testing
・Reinforcing bar tensile tests
・Static loading test of truss structures
・Wood compression experiments

[Environmental experiments]
・Measurement and evaluation of solar radiation
・Landscape evaluation
・Measurement and evaluation of odor and airborne substances
・Proposal and evaluation of thermal/light environments
・Energy-saving diagnosis

Credits will not be awarded unless all report assignments are submitted. Lateness or absences carry great point deductions.
